min_pulse_width.title: Filter min pulse width
min_pulse_width.description:
Input filter minimum pulse width.
Minimum number of PLAY clock cycles to be considered as a valid input signal.
This value is used to filter out short pulses on the input signal.
Value 0 means no filtering.

mode.title: Filter edge detect
mode.description:
Input filter edge detection mode.
Only the selected edge(s) is considered for the input signal.
The signal after the filter will be one PLAY clock cycle in length.

truth_table_expr.title: Logical table expression (optional)
truth_table_expr.description:
Boolean logic expression for LUT (e.g., 'A & B | !C ^ D').
This field supports a maximum of 4 inputs: A, B, C, and D, which correspond to the 4 inputs of the LUT.
You can use any subset of these inputs if you don't need all of them. Non-specified inputs are treated as 'don't care' and will not affect the output.
Use '&' for AND, '|' for OR, '^' for XOR, '!' for NOT, and parentheses '()' to prioritize operations.

Example expressions: 'A & B | !C', '(A | B) ^ C', '!A & (B | C)'.

actions.message: Configure LUT to access this field.
